gemini.name: [MLH] Best Use of Gemini API
gemini.description:
AI-powered apps with the Gemini API. Choose a challenge that fits your project and show how its technology helps bring your idea to life.
Prize: MLH Swag Kits.

elevenlabs.name: [MLH] Best Use of ElevenLabs
elevenlabs.description:
Expressive voice experiences with ElevenLabs. Choose a challenge that fits your project and show how its technology helps bring your idea to life.
Prize: Wireless Earbuds.

databricks.name: Databricks: Best Use of Databricks
databricks.description:
Build a solution that uses Databricks to turn data into useful insights, predictions, or actions that address a real-world problem. Bring in data of your choice, prepare it, and use Databricks analytics, machine learning, or AI capabilities to power your solution. Demonstrate a working prototype that connects the work done in Databricks to a useful result.
Prizes: 1st place: Databricks backpack + water bottle. 2nd place: Databricks backpack or water bottle. 3rd place: Remaining Databricks backpack or water bottle.

bny.name: BNY: Financial Services Challenge
bny.description:
Make financial services work better! Build a tool or application that improves a process in the industry, whether you simplify data management, improve client experiences, automate workflows, or tackle another problem that could make a difference.
Prizes: 1st place: Lululemon Everyday backpack + BNY Stanley + JBL headphones. 2nd place: BNY swag bag with a BNY backpack, JBL headphones, BNY mug, laptop sleeve, and BNY umbrella.

overall.name: Best Overall Hack
overall.description: This track is our most prestigious, and is awarded to the team who really steals the show, making something truly unique and spectacular!

best_ai.name: Best AI Hack
best_ai.description: This track is for the hack that pushes the boundary of AI use! This does not mean that it was coded with AI - it must feature some sort of model, whether it be classic machine learning algorithms, computer vision, LLMs, etc.

best_game.name: Best Game Hack
best_game.description: This track is for the best game your team can make in 36 hours—think of it as a mini-game jam! Show us something creative, engaging, and most of all, fun!

most_useful.name: Most “Useful” Hack
most_useful.description:
This track is for the most “useful” project submitted. A truly life changing project. One that people could not live without. On par with solving world hunger, or discovering human immortality.
Note: we are actually looking for the funniest and goofiest project…
